## Overview

Memo “derived metadata” for lists/previews splits into two layers:

1. **Stored `MemoPayload`** — persisted in `memo.payload` (JSON), rebuilt when content changes.
2. **API conversion derivations** — computed on every response build from raw `content` (not stored), chiefly `snippet`.

Core parsing lives in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`; storage orchestration in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`; API mapping in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`.

---

## 1. Stored `MemoPayload` (persisted)

### Schema

```7:28:proto/store/memo.proto
message MemoPayload {
  Property property = 1;
  Location location = 2;
  repeated string tags = 3;
  // The calculated properties from the memo content.
  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
    string title = 5;
  }
  ...
}
```

`location` is **not** content-derived; it is set from API request fields on create/update.

### Computation site

**Orchestrator** — `RebuildMemoPayload` writes tags + property into the in-memory memo before DB persist:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

**Parser** — `ExtractAll` (single AST walk via goldmark + GFM + custom `#tag` / `@mention` extensions):

```355:421:internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
	...
	data := &ExtractedData{
		Tags:     []string{},
		Mentions: []string{},
		Property: &storepb.MemoPayload_Property{},
	}
	...
	// tags: mast.TagNode, skipping tags inside links/images (asMemoTagNode)
	// mentions: mast.MentionNode → lowercased username (NOT stored in MemoPayload)
	// property.title: first block-level child of document if H1
	// property.has_link: gast.KindLink
	// property.has_code: CodeBlock | FencedCodeBlock | CodeSpan
	// property.has_task_list / has_incomplete_tasks: east.KindTaskCheckBox
	...
	data.Tags = uniquePreserveCase(data.Tags)
	data.Mentions = uniquePreserveCase(data.Mentions)
	return data, nil
}
```

Equivalent property logic also exists in `ExtractProperties` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:192-240`); production payload rebuild uses `ExtractAll` only.

Markdown service is configured with tag + mention extensions at API startup:

```48:51:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
```

### Properties extracted into `MemoPayload`

| Field | Source in content |
|--------|-------------------|
| `tags` | `#tag` inline nodes (`internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`), excluding tags inside links/images; deduped preserving case |
| `property.has_link` | Any markdown link node |
| `property.has_task_list` | Any GFM task checkbox |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` | Any unchecked task checkbox |
| `property.has_code` | Code block, fenced code block, or inline code span |
| `property.title` | Plain text of the **first block-level child** of the document if it is an H1 |

`ExtractAll` also collects `Mentions`, but **`RebuildMemoPayload` does not persist them** — mentions are used only at notification time (see below).

### Production triggers that **recompute and store** payload

| Operation | Path | Condition |
|-----------|------|-----------|
| **CreateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108-110` | Always, before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56` → `CreateMemo` | Same path (comment is a memo) |
| **UpdateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451` | Only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` |

Create also sets `payload.location` from the request **after** rebuild (`memo_service.go:111-113`). Update `"location"` mutates `payload.Location` directly without re-parsing content (`memo_service.go:481-484`).

### Operations that do **not** recompute stored payload

- `UpdateMemo` for `visibility`, `pinned`, `state`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `attachments`, `relations`
- `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`
- `touchMemoUpdatedTimestamp` (`memo_update_helpers.go:16-24`)
- `DeleteMemo`, reactions, shares, etc.

### Non-production batch rebuild

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:26-72`) rebuilds **all** memos in batches — but it is **not wired** into server startup (unlike `s3presign` in `server/server.go:163`). It is a maintenance utility, not a live production trigger.

---

## 2. API conversion derivations (not stored)

### Mapping stored payload → API `Memo`

`convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` copies stored fields and derives `snippet` from raw content:

```47:51:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go
	if memo.Payload != nil {
		memoMessage.Tags = memo.Payload.Tags
		memoMessage.Property = convertMemoPropertyFromStore(memo.Payload.Property)
		memoMessage.Location = convertLocationFromStore(memo.Payload.Location)
	}
```

```315:325:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go
func convertMemoPropertyFromStore(property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property) *v1pb.Memo_Property {
	...
	return &v1pb.Memo_Property{
		HasLink:            property.HasLink,
		HasTaskList:        property.HasTaskList,
		HasCode:            property.HasCode,
		HasIncompleteTasks: property.HasIncompleteTasks,
		Title:              property.Title,
	}
}
```

```76:80:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go
	snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)
	...
	memoMessage.Snippet = snippet
```

### `snippet` computation (API-only, every response build)

```83:89:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
	...
	return snippet, nil
}
```

`GenerateSnippet` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:263-345`):
- Parses markdown to AST
- Walks text nodes, auto-links, `#tags`; skips code blocks
- Inserts spaces between block elements
- Truncates to **64 runes** at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord` → `" ..."`)

### Every API path that recomputes `snippet` at read time

All paths through `convertMemoFromStore` / `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`:

- `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, `ListMemoComments`, `DeleteMemo` (webhook payload), `GetMemoByShare`

Additional snippet-only sites:

| Site | File | When |
|------|------|------|
| `batchConvertMemoRelations` | `memo_service_converter.go:224-253` | `includeSnippets == true` (single-memo relation load, notifications) |
| `convertMemoRelationFromStore` | `memo_relation_service.go:154-164` | `ListMemoRelations` per relation |
| `memoNotificationSnippet` | `user_service_notifications.go:318-327` | Inbox notification payloads |

`ListMemos` calls `batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)` (`memo_service.go:297`) — list relation objects omit snippets; main memo `snippet` still comes from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`.

### Runtime-only extraction (not stored, not in API `Memo`)

`resolveMentionTargets` calls `ExtractAll` again on content for mention inbox notifications (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32-35`). Mentions are **not** part of `MemoPayload` or API `Memo`.

---

## 3. How lists/previews consume this

**Server-driven list cards** (`PagedMemoList` → `MemoView` → `MemoBody`) render **`memo.content`** via `MemoContent`, not `snippet`. They use stored/API fields for metadata:

- `memo.tags` — blur overlay (`MemoView.tsx:34`)
- `memo.property` — server-side list filters (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks` in `internal/filter/schema.go:186-228`; client builds CEL in `useMemoFilters.ts:73-78`)

**`snippet`** is used for compact previews elsewhere:
- Relation links (`MemoDetailSidebar`, `RelationCard`, `useLinkMemo`)
- Comment preview rows (`MemoCommentListView.tsx:45`)
- User memo map (`UserMemoMap.tsx:154`)
- Notification API payloads

**Client-local preview** (`MemoPreview.tsx`) uses the **raw `content` prop** passed from the editor — no server derivation; it does not use `memo.snippet` or recompute payload fields.

---

## Summary diagram

```
content (markdown)
    │
    ├─[CreateMemo / UpdateMemo(content)]─► RebuildMemoPayload
    │         └─ ExtractAll ─► memo.payload { tags, property.* }
    │                              └─ persisted in DB
    │
    └─[every convertMemoFromStore]─► getMemoContentSnippet
              └─ GenerateSnippet(content, 64) ─► Memo.snippet (API only)
```

**Stored:** `tags`, `property.{has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title}` (+ user-supplied `location`).

**API-only at response time:** `snippet` (+ relation/notification snippets).

**Extracted but not stored:** `mentions` (notification side effects only).
